notes.title: Update 13
notes.notes:
Today, the new update has been released! I'm happy to announce that the full update features 40 new room layouts, which doubles the amount of room layouts that have been in the game so far. 
On top of that, I've overhauled the Trinkets menu, which should be much easier and nicer to view and use. Additionally, the character menu was also updated to have better visibility and comfort. Plus a bunch of other quality of life changes and additions like a new Totem and other things that you have to find yourselves.

This is my thank you to the community that has been supporting me through the years. Have fun!

notes.title: Update 12.5 is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8953823/d7a8e016564aa1d3129e0cd737ee85bec49aecfe.png[/img]

As my special thanks to the community, I'm working on a rather big update. Since it's going to take a while until it is fully-fledged out, I've decided to release it in two parts. So this is update 12.5!

The main feature is: 20 new room layouts! Please keep in mind that these are based on previous layouts and are better called "alternate versions" of existing layouts. However, I've made sure to make them different enough to provide a completely new experience when you enter them. Permanently locked doors are now open and accessible areas may now be closed off in this alternate universe.

On top of that, you can unlock 16 new memories that may or may not haunt you in your nightmares.

This update also features lots of improvements to the netcode stability and is aimed to make the experience smoother.

There are also other changes that can be viewed [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/7074686732306815995/]here[/url]

notes.title: TOWN OF MACHINE: New Game Release soon!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce that my new game Town of Machine will release soon on Steam! Check out the new store page and add it to your wishlist!

[previewyoutube=R3ROjCwDZFQ;full][/previewyoutube]
700 years from now, Agent Silverman is a renowned Exorcist on the case of a missing person. His investigation leads him to a small ghost town called "Town of Machine". Uncover unspeakable horrors and fight the grotesque monstrosities that lurk in this forsaken place.

notes.title: ABYSS Update is Live!
notes.notes:
ːheptagramredː[b]Enter the Abyss![/b]
Once a player reaches level 150, the Abyss difficulty will open. On the Abyss Difficulty, the toughest Challengers in UNLOVED await the player - the Abyss Wanderers. Only those who manage to survive 3 Abyss Wanderers in a single map will be rewarded with a new treasure... a legendary Abyss Chest! What do they contain?

ːheptagramredː[b]Abyss Chests and Rank 4 Trinkets![/b]
If a player manages to open an Abyss Chest, they will be rewarded with a new Rank 4 Trinket. These Trinkets all start with level 1 and have to be upgraded by using Abyss Coins. To get Abyss Coins, a player can break an Abyss Chest, Demon Chest or a Ring.

ːheptagramredː[b]New Enemies: Abyss Wanderers[/b]
The Abyss Wanderers are the toughest enemies in UNLOVED so far. They only appear when playing on Abyss difficulty and they come with unique abilities that will turn enemies around them into raging nightmares. Your chances of survival will drop by the second, so once an Abyss Wanderer has come to your realm, make sure to be prepared for a real battle and kill it as fast as you can.

Additional fixes and balance changes have been made as well. To read the full changelog, go here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/1480982338946643162/

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953823/dfae52177c0b3ab57fad28c4126240e7a3c7c9de.jpg[/img]
Today, I've released the new update that brings a whole new level of difficulty to UNLOVED. With Challenges, you can add a new layer of pain to your game. From weapon restrictions over fast monsters, specific enemy themes or the ultimate Rotten Only Challenge. Play Challenges to earn Rubies that can upgrade your new Ring Trinkets.

A total of 22 new Ring Trinkets have been added to the game. These special Trinkets can be upgraded up to a level of 200 using Rubies. They have all kinds of special upgrades that further enhance your style of play.

Another new thing are Wildcard layouts. These special room layouts have special unnatural vibes and they can spawn no matter what location you have picked.

There's a lot more things like player invincibility after joining a game to make the exprience smoother. If you want to read all the changes, you can go here:

notes.title: New Update: Of Angels and Chaos
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953823/296004edfce3d08918666ba8117454a4aa215e8a.jpg[/img]

This new update brings a couple of new features and improvements to UNLOVED!

Two new Totems can now be found: the Amulet of Chaos which gives a chance to turn enemies insane when they see you. Insane enemies will simply attack anything on sight, even their own kin!

The other new Totem is the Amulet of Heavens. This item gives you the possibility to find a Guardian Angel! These special demons will become your ally when they see you. Guardian Angels will follow you and protect you from other demons!

I've also added a new feature to highlight objects and enemies - which is especially useful for multiplayer games. It writes down a small notice in pink that other players can read and it gives the object an outline for 5 seconds. For some players this option is turned off by default. To enable it, go to controls and hit 'reset' - this should show the last entry called 'highlight'. Now you can assign a new key for it if you want.

There are also some improvements to enemy AI, menus, balance and more :)

To read the full changelog, go here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/224446614468375054/

notes.title: New Update with your One-Liners and Ragdoll fix!
notes.notes:
Special thanks to community members Moki, DarkFalz, Godsdoomer, Spazzmaticus, Julius Seizure, oXYnary, Sonnenblume, Captain Chaos and Ribo Zurai for the new One-Liner suggestions! In the past week I've asked for new One-Liners that the game could throw at you occasionally. Great work :)

Besides the new One-Liners, there are now additional Weapon Mods in the game called "Ammo Pouch" - they increase the max ammo and ammo pickups for the specific weapon you've found it for.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953823/7742fff45c2cba9b8ee15a115b71da3b436be38e.jpg[/img]
As some of you have pointed out, the ragdolls in the game can sometimes act a bit strangely. While this might create some scary or bizarre scenarios, this was not intentional and I'm currently working on a fix. Since this issue is netcode / lag related, it is very hard for me to troubleshoot alone. Any help from the community to help track this issue down (if this update didn't already fix it) is appreciated!

By the by: I am always available on the Steam discussion boards if you want to suggest anything or if you're having trouble with the game.

Read the full changelog here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/282992646977669294/

notes.title: Full Version Release!
notes.notes:
After one year of Early Access, UNLOVED has now reached a point where I am very satisfied with the games balance, look and gameplay. I want to thank the whole community for all the feedback, suggestions and support they have given me during the Early Access phase. I am very proud of UNLOVED and everyone who helped me make it as awesome as possible, I thank you very much :)

New Weapon: The Railgun
The second heavy weapon in the players arsenal is the most powerful weapon in the game. The Railgun has very high fire power, but has a long delay between shots. The primary fire mode shoots one fat beam of death that deals heavy damage to everything in its path. The secondary fire mode shoots a barrage of lasers that bounce off walls and also deal lots of damage. The high fire power is compensated with limited ammo reserves, so take your shots carefully.

To read the full changelog of the new version, go here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/350543389010757944/

notes.title: Final Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
UNLOVED has been in Early Access for a year and it has come a long way. I want to thank the community whole-heartedly for all the suggestions and feedback that made UNLOVED even more bad ass over this time.

The final version of UNLOVED will be released on 29 September!!

For this special occasion, I've prepared a new trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=31MEW7_S1Io

Also, you can check out the new UNLOVED website here: www.unloved-thegame.com

Here's what's new in the final version:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953823/49726bfb7aaac4fb2d4a5c97b5ea6d47e7ba44d4.jpg[/img]
The Town! The community favorite location of the Doom2 mod was the spooky outdoor area: The Faded Town. This very misterious place will be the fourth location of UNLOVED and it has a very similar atmosphere to the location of the mod.

And The Railgun! This is the second heavy weapon in the players arsenal, meaning that you cannot start with this weapon and it has to be picked up within the map. This weapon does not have any magazine, but instead gets reloaded with a pump action mechanic between shots. The primary fire mode shoots a high powered particle beam that penetrates every enemy in a straight line with heavy damage. The secondary fire mode shoots plasma shards that scatter like a shotgun but can also bounce off walls.

I will make another dev video to show you the Railgun once the art and sounds are in place.

Until then... mark your calenders, the 29 September is going to be bad ass :)

notes.notes:
In this rather small update, I've focused on polishing the multiplayer experience. One big focus is giving the player better informations about a game before joining.

Before joining a game, you can now see game details of the host like difficulty, area size, level of the host and map name! This gives you a much better way to decide wether or not the game is suitable for you to join or not.

To read the full changelog, you can go here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/358415738188575244/

notes.title: Get ready to Penetrate! Update: The NAILGUN!
notes.notes:
Finally, after long last, the Nailgun is finally here!

New Weapon: The Nailgun!
This new beast is the first heavy weapon in the player's arsenal. It shoots heavy nails that penetrate through multiple enemies in a straight line. The secondary fire mode is a grenade launcher that explodes in a devestating blast. This weapon is more powerful than the other weapons and cannot be taken as a starting weapon. It comes with new Weapon Mods and a new Trinket slot that can hold one of the 7 new Trinkets to increase this already powerful killing machine. Have fun :)

There are plenty of other new things in this update. Check it out over here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/358415206081070517/

notes.title: New Update! Twisted Mode, Ranks and more...
notes.notes:
In this update, I've added three new major things.

First, you can now play the game in a "twisted map" mode. Here, you will get a map that is arranged from rooms that are taken from every Location in the game, instead of just one particular. This makes the game incredibly unpredictable and the new randomly colored fog gives your unique creation a very eerie feeling.

Next are the Ranks. You can now unlock Ranks that can be seen by other players in multiplayer. Besides these Ranks, you can see all your statistics now in a new menu under "Unlockables".

And finally, I've added several users from the Steam community to the Credits of the game! If you have helped me in the past to make the game better, chances are that your name is in the credits now. If you don't want your name attached to the game, let me know and I'll remove it.

To read the full change log, go here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/364041776195724631/

notes.title: Update! Custom Input Support + HOT MODE
notes.notes:
Two major things going on! No, actually three!
First off - a long awaited feature by many has finally made it into the game: custom input support! You can now rebind your keyboard and gamepad keys and buttons to match your desired comfort. Currently there is a small issue with rebinding mouse input, but this is already being worked on.

Also a new game mode is introduced: Hot Mode. It's the most innovative game mode in years. Time moves only when you move! Enemies are a lot stronger now, but you can use slow motion to do epic maneuvers to dodge them now.

And the third major thing is that UNLOVED got a lot of performance upgrades! It now runs on the latest Unreal Engine version, which is heavily optimized on performance and I've added a new blood counter to fix performance issues when every wall is covered in blood.

Try it out ;)

To read the full changelog, go here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/371919771763417758/

notes.title: New Update: The FACELESS is unleashed!!
notes.notes:
What the recent update brings (among other various additions and fixes):
New Enemy: The Faceless
A new enemy has entered the realm of UNLOVED! This demon is a huge monster that will barrage you with fireballs. It has only one goal: to consume your flesh and wear your skin! It comes with an alternate version which is the Soulless - a forsaken monstrosity that can take a ton of damage and is also deadly in close combat!

New Gamemode: Arcade Style
In this new game mode, you can instantly pick up objects and the fast paced action of the original game mode is made even faster. Only those with lightning fast reflexes have a chance to survive the increased hordes of enemies. This mode is currently for testing purposes only playable in single player, so let me know what you think :)

You can read the full changelog here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/458606877318921905/

notes.title: Update adds new Clinic Roomlayout
notes.notes:
Happy New Year to everyone :)
To kick this year off, we're starting with an update that adds a new Clinic room layout and a few other things. The new layout is slightly smaller compared to the other layouts of the Clinic to reduce the average room amount for a Clinic run. I'll add a few more of these more simple layouts to make Clinic runs less complex and more in line with Apartment layouts.

Also I've added Pistol Magnum sounds that will replace the normal weapon sounds once you equip the Magnum trinket - to make it more satisfying to blast enemies across the room ;)

There's now also screen resolution scaling, which is very helpful to tweak your performance without reducing your resolution.

Read the full changelog here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/458604254462646524/

notes.title: New Update brings Tactical Goggles, Ghost Ammo and more!
notes.notes:
Another update has arrived. This time I have added new gameplay changing effects that you can pick up by collecting one of the new Totems.

Tactical Goggles:
Picking up this Totem gives you the ability to see enemies on your minimap within a certain range. This can completely change the perspective you have on the game and can give you a completely new tactical advantage.

Vampire Tooth:
This item gives your melee attacks the addition of life leech. Another gameplay changer, because whenever you're low on health, instead of picking up an item, you can instead choose to leech your health back from enemies using your Kukri.

Ghost Ammo:
There are now three ghost ammo Totems in the game, giving you a chance to reload your weapon without reducing the total ammo you have.

There are also some other changes and fixes in this update and if you want to read the full change list, you can do that over here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/494631967660496075/

notes.title: Update! Visuals got significant update, more Trinkets and Totems!
notes.notes:
With this update I've added two major new features. 

First off, UNLOVED now has fully dynamic Ambient Occlusion which gives the whole game a new improved look. Using AO in modern games is nothing new, but in UNLOVED this task was something special - because AO is not designed for dynamic environments like in this game, so it was a little bit tricky to get it to work - but now it revamps the whole game and gives everything a better sense of depth!

Second, the Trinket Manager got an overhaul and also 4 new Trinket slots, 14 new Trinkets and 3 new Totems have been added to the game. This gives you much more options to customize your gear towards the playstyle you prefer.

It's now also much easier to upgrade existing Trinkets with the use of Fragments. You can break Trinkets you don't like into Fragments and use them to upgrade the Trinkets you do like. You can also break Ink Bottles into Fragments to upgrade your Trinkets. It's now also much easier to get higher rank Trinkets by completing a level.

Read the full change log here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/492378265880903283/

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE + Sale!
notes.notes:
In this update, a new enemy has come to haunt your nightmares - The Clown! Its a disgusting being that sends the souls of its victims after you, chasing you down no matter where you run.

Also a new game mode is introduced: Classic Horror!
This new mode is inspired by horror game classics like the old Resident Evil games (1-3) and the first few Silent Hill games. It has barely enough ammo to let you survive and enemies are lethal as hell! This mode is experimental at this stage, so multiplayer is disabled. Let me know what you think!

UNLOVED is on Sale during the Halloween time, so if you have a friend who you want to play with - now is your time to tell him about it :)

As always, you can take a look at the full changelog here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/496879865898657516/

notes.title: Clinic Release Date: October 12th
notes.notes:
It's almost complete! The first content upgrade for UNLOVED: The Clinic. The release date is now set in stone and I'm happy to announce that it is the

[b]12th of October 2015[/b]

What can you expect?
[b]Two new Enemy Types[/b]
The Demon Nurse that will viciously chase you to cut you up with her gigantic scalpel. The other one is the Lobotomized Doctor. It has not been shown in the trailer - but it is a terrifying hulking abomination that has done several experiments on itself and now it is looking for new specimens. Both enemy types will come with a variation, effectively increasing the enemy roster by 4 in total.

[b]New Weapon[/b]
The Silenced Machine Pistol will be your new tool in your arsenal. It comes with its own new Weapon Mods and with its high rate of fire it is a great addition to your loadout. The silenced gunsounds also make enemies uncapable of detecting you when you shoot, so it is another strategic element that you can utilize to survive.

[b]New Area[/b]
A whole new set of unique room layouts have been designed. Hunt or be hunted in endless hospital corridors, disgusting operation theaters, twisted x-ray stations or creepy, candlelit bedrooms full of grotesque monstrosities. This new area also features new music specifically composed to fit the atmosphere perfectly by James Dean!

[b]New Trinkets and Achievements[/b]
New Trinkets have been added to the game to give you a greater choice to plan your strategy and finetune your play-style. Also new Steam Achievements have been added for the new weapon and monsters (and a few extra ones).

Please note that the Clinic upgrade will also come with a price adjustment for the added value of the game. The base price will be increased by $1 or regional equivalent. If you purchase the game before the new content is released, you will get it all for free!

notes.title: Update 0.1.12 live!
notes.notes:
This update includes the latest version of the Unreal Engine 4. Also, a lot of improvements and fixes that were asked by the community are in the game now - for example a request about disabling Motion Blur.

Overall netcode was improved to make it use up less packages, to give you a smoother experience.

Also another balance update has taken place, reducing amount of enemy health on higher difficulties and reducing damage the Butchers deal while increasing spawn rate, giving the game a faster, more action oriented pace while keeping overall difficulty intact.

As always, let me know what you think and you can read the full changelog here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/523897023723017875/

notes.title: New Update 0.1.9
notes.notes:
The second update is out! This update focuses on Trinkets and overall pacing of the game. A Trinket Manager has been added that is very useful to upgrade your Trinkets or craft completely new ones that you cannot obtain in any other way!

Also Enemy spawns have a new cooldown to prevent floods of enemies that never seemed to end. Area sizes have also been reduced to give the game a faster pace.

Another addition is a better reward system that rewards the players with more Trinkets for completing larger areas.

notes.title: New Update 0.1.9
notes.notes:
The second update is out! This update focuses on Trinkets and overall pacing of the game. A Trinket Manager has been added that is very useful to upgrade your Trinkets or craft completely new ones that you cannot obtain in any other way!

Also Enemy spawns have a new cooldown to prevent floods of enemies that never seemed to end. Area sizes have also been reduced to give the game a faster pace.

Another addition is a better reward system that rewards the players with more Trinkets for completing larger areas.

Also thanks to Vom, the Gelatinous Spider, the texture quality in the whole game has been improved!

Complete patch notes can be found here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/321270/discussions/0/528398719813114999/

As always, please leave your feedback and suggestions in the Steam discussion boards! They are very helpful for me to improve the game :)

Thanks and have a great day!

notes.title: Update Video #18 Coop Gameplay & Release info
notes.notes:
New development video is up! The gameplay you can see here was recorded yesterday with my friend - it was basically a test run to see if the latest updates work over Steam. However, we had a lot of fun in this early and unbalanced stage and I think when the objectives and character leveling systems are in place, this will be a blast :)

Basically what is left for me to do is some balancing, polish and the player progression.

Second topic is the release date. I know a lot of you are eager to know when the game is finally released. Currently I'm trying my best to release the game in mid August. If some unexpected problems come up, I may push the date back by maybe a week or two, but I will keep you updated on that.

https://youtu.be/VQErAL8GYqQ
